propositions: Add filter: blob:none input to actions/checkout@v7 in reconcile-bridge.yml, verify-identity.yml, and reconcile-bridge-canary.yml while retaining fetch-depth: 0 and existing credential/ref settings
Add --filter=blob:none to both depth-1 and full-history direct-URL tickets fetches in gerrit-verify.yaml, preserving their different depth semantics

Implement production guardrails that parse git count-objects -v pack size immediately after checkout/materialization and fail if exceeding REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=102400 or REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=131072

Create real-Git test fixture with git daemon, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL filter support, and GIT_TRACE_PACKET inspection to verify blob:none filter capability negotiation and missing-blob oracle across named-remote and direct-URL fetch paths
Verify that blobless materialized tickets preserve complete commit graph for merge-base/era scoping and that verify-identity scanning adds no additional objects after materialization
